subject.title: Control UI chat history hardcoded to 100 messages, no load more pagination

question: Should this issue be fixed by older-message pagination using `chat.history` offsets, or is a larger fixed Control UI history batch sufficient to close it?
rationale: Current source proves the 100-message cap and the backend paging contract, but repository docs intentionally describe bounded recent history for stability, so the UX/performance tradeoff needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Require pagination
options.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand while preserving a bounded initial payload.

options.title: Accept larger fixed batch
options.body: Close this only after a maintainer-sponsored limit increase lands and documents that fixed-batch history is the intended behavior.

recommendation.title: Require pagination
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until Control UI can fetch older history pages on demand while preserving a bounded initial payload.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is mostly product shape and Control UI history UX, and this person has substantial adjacent history in the prior chat controller path.
